play.title: LoonPop: Balloon Adventure
play.shortDescription: Keep the balloon in the air with a leaf blower – and dodge the needles!
play.fullDescription:
A leaf blower that follows your finger and tilts – and a balloon you have to steer through needles with it.

In LoonPop you keep a balloon in the air with a leaf blower and guide it upwards through rows of needles. The blower follows your finger and tilts in the direction it moves, up to 40 degrees – the further your finger leads, the more it leans and the harder it pushes the balloon sideways. Standing still, it blows straight up, and the edge of the air stream nudges the balloon to the side. A quick swipe gives a gust of wind. Sounds easy? The balloon has inertia: it reacts with a delay and keeps drifting after you let go. Think ahead and you win.

FOUR WORLDS, 51 LEVELS
Meadow, City, Desert and Night: 15 levels in the meadow, 12 in each of the others. Crosswinds, downdrafts, swinging and falling needles, sliding rows of needles and tight passages. Every level has up to three stars: reach the goal, beat the star time, collect all three coins. Stars from one world unlock the next, and coins buy new balloons.

DAILY FLIGHT
A new run every day, the same for everyone. Set your daily best and keep your streak alive.

ENDLESS MODE
Up and up, as far as you can go. It keeps getting faster, and again and again narrow passages appear, glowing red. How many metres can you make?

ALSO
• 9 balloon skins, including heart, hot-air balloon and gold
• New 3D look with pops, confetti and more
• After popping, fly on once – with an optional video
• One finger is all you need
• 13 languages
• Plays offline, no internet connection needed
• No account needed
• Remove ads with a one-time purchase
• Sound and haptics, both can be switched off
